video.title: AI欧腐《逃不掉的Alpha/The Alpha He Couldn't Outrun》
video.desc:
古早味剧本
Six years ago, penniless Omega Hayden was bought off to leave top Alpha Jace—secretly raising their son alone. Reunited, a bitter Jace traps him: "You're for sale? Then I'll buy you." But a 99.9% DNA match blows the lid off the lies, revealing Jace has been hating the wrong man all along.
六年前，一贫如洗的 Omega Hayden 被收买离开了顶级 Alpha Jace——此后一直独自秘密抚养着他们的儿子。重逢之时，满心怨恨的 Jace 设下陷阱："你是被买走的？那我买回来。" 然而 99.9% 的 DNA 吻合率揭开了谎言的真相，原来 Jace 这六年来一直恨错了人。
